summary: The service is testable but not observable: the highest-risk item is the swallowed exception, because a failed write looks like success.

suggestions.action: Replace the swallowed exception in createOrder with an error response
suggestions.why: a failed write currently returns HTTP 200, so the caller cannot tell success from failure

suggestions.action: Move the fee percentage out of the literal and into configuration
suggestions.why: the fee is a pricing rule that lives in code; every change becomes a deploy

suggestions.action: Add a test for the customer endpoint with an unknown id
suggestions.why: the current behaviour returns an empty body with status 200, which no client can act on

suggestions.action: Reduce latency by 40% by caching everything
